Metadata.title: Development Plan for AgentMemBank MCP Server
Metadata.approval: Architecture approved by user; Agent UX + Admin Observability extension approved 2026-05-10.

ArchitecturePrinciples.principle: Vault Markdown files are the source of truth.
Index, embeddings, audit projections and wiki pages are derivative layers.
All writes are planned through policy, change planning, lock/revision and audit boundaries.
Mutation services return affected_paths; index refresh is coordinated by entrypoint or background worker.
No delete, bulk move, unrestricted rename or direct autonomous Wiki writes in MVP.
Agent-facing write destinations are governed by authoritative Directory Contract, never by agent folder-name inference.
Admin dashboard is read-only/debug-only and must not become a Vault mutation path.

Module.name: MCPServerEntrypoint
Module.purpose: Exposes Streamable HTTP MCP tools and coordinates auth, policy, mutation, retrieval, index refresh and health endpoints.
Module.scope: Tool registration, request routing, auth/policy orchestration, service invocation, affected_paths handoff, health/admin endpoints. Must forward actual dry_run parameter to mutation services; must call M-006.prepare_change via M-008 for ALL mutation types (create/append/edit/write). Index refresh after mutation is synchronous in handler (blocking); background worker pattern is future optimization.
Module.observability: Must create trace_id and emit tool routing, policy outcome and service result anchors.
Module.rationale: Central orchestration keeps MCP transport thin while preventing service-to-service cycles such as mutation directly refreshing index.

Module.name: MCPTransport
Module.purpose: Provides aiohttp-based Streamable HTTP MCP transport with JSON-RPC 2.0 handling, Bearer token auth, MCP method routing and health endpoint.
Module.scope: JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST /message; Bearer token extraction from Authorization header; MCP version negotiation (2024-11-05); initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call, ping routing; GET /health endpoint; graceful shutdown on SIGTERM/SIGINT; invalid JSON and unknown method error handling.
Module.observability: Emit transport.starting; every JSON-RPC error response must include error code per STANDARD_ERROR_CODES.
Module.rationale: A separate transport module keeps HTTP concerns isolated from MCP tool logic, enabling transport-level testing independently of Vault operations.

Module.name: InstructionService
Module.purpose: Builds role-aware AgentMemBank instructions from identity, policy profile and authoritative Directory Contract.
Module.scope: get_instructions payload composition, role capability guidance, safe workflow examples, drift warnings and forbidden alias guidance.
Module.observability: Emit instructions.generated, instructions.role_context.included and instructions.layout_warning.included.
Module.rationale: Server-owned instructions prevent agents from guessing write destinations or role permissions from incomplete tool descriptions.

Module.name: VaultLayoutService
Module.purpose: Detects Obsidian vault root and resolves authoritative Directory Contract for all agent-facing folders.
Module.scope: Obsidian marker detection, semantic directory keys, canonical paths, aliases, drift reports, destination resolution and init readiness.
Module.observability: Emit vault_layout.detected, vault_layout.drift_detected, vault_layout.obsidian_marker_missing and vault_layout.canonical_paths.resolved.
Module.rationale: Directory selection must be deterministic and enforceable across the whole Vault structure, not only the inbox example.

Module.name: MemBankInitializationService
Module.purpose: Safely checks, plans and applies AgentMemBank Directory Contract initialization over an existing Obsidian Vault.
Module.scope: check_only layout diagnostics, dry_run init plan, safe apply for missing canonical folders/projection, idempotency and audit event handoff.
Module.observability: Emit membank_init.plan.created, membank_init.apply.started, membank_init.apply.completed and membank_init.drift_blocked.
Module.rationale: Initialization modifies operational structure and must be planned, idempotent, auditable and non-destructive.

Module.name: AdminAuthService
Module.purpose: Authenticates human admin dashboard sessions using login/password credentials separate from MCP API keys.
Module.scope: Admin credential validation, session creation, session validation, revocation, timeout and safe failure logging.
Module.observability: Emit admin_auth.login.success, admin_auth.login.failed, admin_auth.session.validated and admin_auth.session.revoked without logging passwords.
Module.rationale: Human dashboard authentication and agent API-key identity are separate trust domains and should not share credential semantics.

Module.name: ProcessEventLogService
Module.purpose: Records durable structured process events for admin timelines, filtering, report export and trace correlation.
Module.scope: Process event recording, query filters, trace correlation, redaction and storage through the index database boundary.
Module.observability: Emit process_event.recorded, process_event.query.completed and process_event.redacted.
Module.rationale: Operational debug events are broader than mutation audit and need queryable storage without becoming Vault source of truth.

Module.name: LogReportService
Module.purpose: Builds sanitized line-oriented .log reports from process and audit events with date/time and dimension filters.
Module.scope: Report filter validation, audit/process event correlation, redaction, max size bounds and .log formatting.
Module.observability: Emit log_report.created, log_report.exported and log_report.redacted.
Module.rationale: Portable debug exports need a dedicated redaction and formatting boundary instead of leaking dashboard or database internals.

Module.name: AdminDashboardService
Module.purpose: Aggregates read-only admin dashboard data: health, events, errors, file changes, MCP requests, layout drift and report exports.
Module.scope: Dashboard summary, recent events, error timeline, process details, report request handoff and degraded-mode results.
Module.observability: Emit admin_dashboard.summary.generated, admin_dashboard.events.filtered and admin_dashboard.degraded.
Module.rationale: Dashboard aggregation should be UI-agnostic and read-only so the web layer cannot become a direct mutation surface.

Module.name: AdminWebInterface
Module.purpose: Provides private read-only admin web pages for login, process timeline, filters and .log export.
Module.scope: Admin routes, login page, dashboard page, event filter request handling, report download response and session enforcement.
Module.observability: Emit admin_web.request.received, admin_web.access.denied, admin_web.dashboard.rendered and admin_web.report.downloaded.
Module.rationale: A thin entry point keeps admin UI private, session-gated and separated from Vault filesystem and audit internals.

Module.name: AuthIdentityService
Module.purpose: Resolves agent identity, API key, role and policy profile.
Module.scope: API key validation, identity mapping, profile resolution, invalid credential rejection.
Module.observability: Emit auth.identity.resolved or auth.identity.rejected without logging secrets.
Module.rationale: Identity resolution is separated from policy decisions so credentials and authorization rules remain independently testable.

Module.name: VaultPolicyGuard
Module.purpose: Enforces allowlist, denylist, no-delete, no-bulk-move, dry-run, propose-only and symlink-deny policies.
Module.scope: Path policy, operation capability matrix, profile-specific permissions, write restrictions, propose-only enforcement.
Module.observability: Emit policy.decision for every read, search, mutation, promotion and wiki operation.
Module.rationale: Centralized policy prevents inconsistent enforcement across tools and reduces the damage radius of autonomous agents.

Module.name: VaultReadService
Module.purpose: Provides safe read/list/exists/metadata operations over allowed Vault paths.
Module.scope: Read note content, list allowed paths, check file existence, compute metadata and revision for allowed files.
Module.observability: Emit read.started and read.completed with path and revision metadata only after policy approval.
Module.rationale: Read operations still need policy enforcement because private Vault paths must not leak through convenience tools.

Module.name: VaultFilesystemRepository
Module.purpose: Performs normalized path resolution, symlink denial, file reads, metadata inspection and atomic writes.
Module.scope: Vault root confinement, path traversal prevention, symlink checks, file IO, atomic write primitive and move primitive.
Module.observability: Emit path.resolved, path.denied, vault.atomic_write.completed and vault.atomic_move.completed.
Module.rationale: Filesystem safety is isolated so every service uses the same normalized path and symlink denial semantics.

Module.name: ChangePlanner
Module.purpose: Builds dry-run diffs, validates constrained patches and creates executable mutation plans.
Module.scope: Patch validation, dry-run diff generation, post-apply Markdown validation, mutation plan creation.
Module.observability: Emit change.plan.created, patch.validation.completed and diff.generated.
Module.rationale: Planning changes before execution makes autonomous writes reviewable and protects against free-form destructive edits.

Module.name: LockAndRevisionService
Module.purpose: Provides hybrid locks and sha256(content) optimistic concurrency checks.
Module.scope: Per-path asyncio locks, filesystem-level locks, expected/current revision comparison, external sync recheck.
Module.observability: Emit lock.acquired, lock.released and revision.rechecked.
Module.rationale: External sync can change files outside local process locks, so write safety requires both locking and content-hash revalidation.

Module.name: VaultMutationService
Module.purpose: Executes approved create/append/edit/write operations through ChangePlanner (M-006), returns affected_paths with diff, and never calls index refresh directly.
Module.scope: Apply MutationPlan via prepare_change for ALL operation types (create, append, edit, write), generate diff, invoke atomic writes, coordinate audit, return mutation results with diff.

fn-create_note.note: Must invoke prepare_change (M-006) to generate unified diff; for new files, diff is full-content addition.

fn-write_note.note: Must invoke prepare_change (M-006) to generate unified diff between old and new content; diff is mandatory even for full-file overwrite.

Module.observability: Emit mutation.started, mutation.affected_paths.returned, mutation.diff.generated and mutation.completed.
Module.anti_pattern: _authorize_or_raise must pass actual dry_run value to authorize_operation, NOT hardcoded True. Policy gate DRY_RUN_REQUIRED must not be bypassable by skipping dry_run at the policy check level.
Module.rationale: Mutation is deliberately decoupled from index refresh to preserve the dependency DAG and make write failures easier to reason about. Every mutation must produce a diff through M-006 so dry-run visibility is uniform across all write operation types.

Module.name: AuditLogService
Module.purpose: Writes authoritative machine-readable audit events and updates LOG.md projection.
Module.scope: Append audit event, write human projection, associate trace_id, avoid recursive audit loops.
Module.observability: Emit audit.authoritative_event.appended and audit.log_projection.updated.
Module.rationale: Machine-readable audit supports verification and forensic reconstruction while LOG.md preserves human-readable Obsidian visibility.

Module.name: RetrievalService
Module.purpose: Provides keyword, FTS, optional semantic, similar-notes, wiki-source retrieval and explainable ranking.
Module.scope: Search query orchestration, FTS retrieval, optional vector retrieval, policy filtering, ranking explanation.
Module.observability: Emit retrieval.query.completed and retrieval.denied_path.filtered.
Module.rationale: Retrieval must filter at response time because derivative indexes may temporarily contain stale entries.

Module.name: ConfigService
Module.purpose: Loads server, Vault, auth, policy, index, audit and backup configuration.
Module.scope: Parse configuration, provide typed settings, validate required settings, expose policy and backend choices.
Module.observability: May expose sanitized config summary; must not log secrets.
Module.rationale: Configuration centralization prevents policy and backend drift between modules.

Module.name: ObservabilityService
Module.purpose: Provides structured logs, request IDs, trace anchors and error taxonomy.
Module.scope: Trace context, structured log helper, error codes, audit correlation IDs.
Module.observability: This module defines the observability surface for all other modules.
Module.rationale: Autonomous execution needs stable trace anchors to diagnose policy, mutation and index failures.

Module.name: IndexRepository
Module.purpose: Maintains SQLite metadata, FTS5, audit-index access and future vector tables derived from Vault files.
Module.scope: SQLite schema, FTS operations, index state, WAL/busy_timeout initialization, derivative metadata persistence.
Module.observability: Emit index.schema.ready and index.fts.query.completed.
Module.rationale: Keeping index persistence separate reinforces that the index is rebuildable and not the source of truth.

Module.name: IndexRefreshService
Module.purpose: Rebuilds or incrementally updates the index from Vault content and affected_paths.
Module.scope: refresh_paths, startup_reconcile, refresh_wiki_folder, single writer queue coordination, optional vector update.
Module.observability: Emit index.refresh.started and index.refresh.completed.
Module.rationale: Refresh is a supervised derivative update triggered outside mutation execution to prevent cycles and preserve write safety.

Module.name: MarkdownSemanticParser
Module.purpose: Extracts frontmatter, tags, links, headings, sections and validates post-apply Markdown shape.
Module.scope: Markdown parsing, section extraction, heading paths, link extraction, post-apply validation.
Module.observability: Emit markdown.parse.completed and markdown.validation.failed when applicable.
Module.rationale: A reusable semantic parser keeps edit validation, indexing and wiki source extraction consistent.

Module.name: VectorSearchAdapter
Module.purpose: Provides optional vector search via disabled/sqlite-vec/qdrant-optional implementations.
Module.scope: Backend selection, vector upsert/query abstraction, graceful degradation to FTS.
Module.observability: Emit vector.mode.selected and vector.degraded_to_fts.
Module.rationale: The boundary describes semantic retrieval capability instead of binding architecture to Qdrant prematurely.

Module.name: BackupService
Module.purpose: Exposes manual Git backup/health integration without implementing rollback API in MVP.
Module.scope: Backup health check, manual backup trigger, status reporting, no content mutation beyond Git operations.
Module.observability: Emit backup.snapshot.completed and backup.health.checked.
Module.rationale: Manual Git backup provides recoverability without adding risky rollback API surface to MVP.

Module.name: WikiUpdateService
Module.purpose: Finds wiki sources and generates propose-only diffs for 70_Wiki.
Module.scope: Wiki source retrieval, proposed update generation, diff output, no autonomous write.
Module.observability: Emit wiki.diff.generated and wiki.sources.selected.
Module.rationale: Wiki pages are synthesized knowledge and should be reviewed as proposed diffs before mutation.

Module.name: DraftPromotionService
Module.purpose: Controls single-note promote/move workflows from inbox or future drafts to approved destinations.
Module.scope: Validate source/destination roots, dry-run, no-overwrite, single-file move, audit event, affected_paths result.
Module.observability: Emit promotion.plan.created and promotion.completed.
Module.rationale: Promotion is a high-risk lifecycle transition and needs a narrower contract than unrestricted move/rename.

forbidden_edge.rationale: Would create mutation/index coupling and risk circular dependency.
Vault layout detection must not call MCP entrypoint.
Instruction composition must be service-only and not route tools.
Initialization service returns result to entrypoint, not call routing.
Init should return affected_paths; index refresh remains entrypoint/background responsibility.
Admin web must not directly read or write Vault files.
Admin web must use LogReportService/DashboardService, not audit internals.
Admin login/password auth must remain separate from MCP API-key identity auth.
Process event logging must not create mutation audit loops.
Audit logging must not depend on process logging for authoritative mutation record.

DataFlow.name: SafeRead
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-004 -> M-005 -> return content + revision + metadata
DataFlow.rationale: Read path passes policy so denylisted content is never exposed.

DataFlow.name: SafeMutation
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-006 -> M-007 -> M-008 -> M-009 -> return mutation result + affected_paths -> M-001/background worker -> M-014
DataFlow.rationale: Mutation planning, revision recheck, atomic write and audit are required before derivative index refresh.

DataFlow.name: RetrievalSearch
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-010 -> M-013/M-016 -> M-003 result filter -> return snippets/sources/ranking explanation
DataFlow.rationale: Retrieval re-checks policy to avoid stale index leaks.

DataFlow.name: IndexRefreshFromMutationResult
DataFlow.sequence: Mutation result -> affected_paths -> M-001/background worker -> M-014 -> M-003 -> M-005 -> M-015 -> M-013 -> optional M-016

DataFlow.name: WikiProposeOnlyUpdate
DataFlow.sequence: Agent -> M-001 -> M-010.find_wiki_sources -> M-018 -> M-006 preview -> return proposal diff
DataFlow.rationale: Wiki automation proposes changes rather than mutating synthesized knowledge directly.

DataFlow.name: DraftInboxPromotion
DataFlow.sequence: Trusted Agent -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-019 -> M-007 -> M-005 -> M-009 -> return affected_paths
DataFlow.rationale: Promotion is constrained to single-note trusted move with dry-run, no-overwrite and audit.

DataFlow.name: AgentInstructionBootstrap
DataFlow.sequence: Agent -> M-001.get_instructions -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-022 -> M-021 -> return role-aware instructions, Directory Contract and drift warnings
DataFlow.rationale: Agents need server-owned context and exact directory guidance before writing.

DataFlow.name: ObsidianVaultDetection
DataFlow.sequence: Startup or check_only -> M-011 -> M-022 -> M-005 -> return vault layout report and drift status
DataFlow.rationale: Vault detection protects the promise that AgentMemBank overlays an existing Obsidian Vault instead of inventing a parallel structure.

DataFlow.name: MemBankInitialization
DataFlow.sequence: Admin/trusted Agent -> M-001.membank_init -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-023 -> M-022 -> M-005 -> M-009 -> return init result
DataFlow.rationale: Initialization is non-destructive but still requires policy, plan/apply separation and audit.

DataFlow.name: ProcessEventRecording
DataFlow.sequence: Critical operation -> M-012 trace anchor -> M-025 process event -> M-013 durable queryable storage
DataFlow.rationale: Admin debugging needs durable filterable process events correlated by trace_id.

DataFlow.name: AdminDashboardAccess
DataFlow.sequence: Admin browser -> M-028 -> M-024 -> M-027 -> M-025/M-026/M-022/M-014/M-017 -> sanitized dashboard response
DataFlow.rationale: Dashboard is session-gated, read-only and aggregated through service boundaries.

DataFlow.name: LogReportExport
DataFlow.sequence: Admin browser -> M-028 -> M-024 -> M-027 -> M-026 -> M-025/M-009 -> sanitized .log response
DataFlow.rationale: Report export must apply consistent redaction and filtering outside the UI layer.

DataFlow.name: DestinationResolution
DataFlow.sequence: User intent -> agent reads get_instructions.directory_contract -> canonical path selected -> write tool -> M-003 -> M-022 validation -> mutation pipeline
DataFlow.rationale: Write destination must be derived from Directory Contract, with server-side validation catching non-canonical or deprecated paths.

Phase.name: FoundationAndPolicy
Phase.rationale: Safety, configuration, identity and path boundaries must exist before any MCP tool can safely expose Vault access.

Phase.name: ReadOnlyMCP
Phase.step: Expose read-only MCP tools over Streamable HTTP.
Phase.rationale: Read-only execution validates transport, identity, policy and path resolution before mutations are introduced.

Phase.name: SafeMutationPipeline
Phase.rationale: Writes are only safe after dry-run, constrained patch validation, hybrid locks, external sync revision recheck and audit exist.

Phase.name: SQLiteFTSRetrieval
Phase.step: Implement IndexRepository with SQLite FTS5 and WAL.
Phase.rationale: Reliable MVP search should be local, rebuildable and policy-filtered before semantic retrieval is added.

Phase.name: PromotionBackupAndOps
Phase.step: Implement BackupService manual Git backup integration.
Phase.rationale: Promotion and backup are operational risk surfaces and must be verified before wiki and semantic expansion.

Phase.name: WikiProposeOnlyAutomation
Phase.step: Support refresh_wiki_folder as index refresh, not autonomous wiki write.
Phase.rationale: Wiki automation is content-risky and must remain propose-only.

Phase.name: OptionalSemanticRetrieval
Phase.step: Extend RetrievalService for hybrid search and similar notes.
Phase.rationale: Semantic retrieval is useful after MVP but must degrade cleanly to FTS and not become a core reliability dependency.

Phase.name: AgentUXAndVaultLayout
Phase.step: Implement VaultLayoutService and authoritative Directory Contract resolution.
Implement InstructionService and expose get_instructions through M-001.
Implement MemBankInitializationService with check_only, dry_run and safe apply.
Update MCP server tool surface for get_instructions and membank_init orchestration.
Phase.rationale: Agents need exact role-aware directory instructions before autonomous writes can be reliable over a user-specific Obsidian Vault.

Phase.name: AdminObservabilityAndDebugUX
Phase.step: Implement ProcessEventLogService and queryable process_events storage.
Implement LogReportService with filters and sanitized .log export.
Implement AdminAuthService with separate login/password sessions.
Integrate admin web routes beside transport without weakening private network boundary.
Phase.rationale: Operational visibility must be added after core safety boundaries and must remain read-only to avoid expanding mutation risk.

Risk.description: Agent overwrites external Obsidian Sync change.
Risk.mitigation: sha256(content) expected_revision plus recheck before write.
affected_paths result; M-001 or background worker calls M-014.
Policy at indexing and response time.
Deny path if any component is symlink.
Trusted profile, dry-run, diff, revision recheck and audit.

Risk.description: SQLite locked under concurrent index writes.
Risk.mitigation: WAL, busy_timeout and single writer queue.
Authoritative SQLite/NDJSON audit and LOG.md projection.

Risk.description: Agent writes into wrong or invented folder because directory structure is inferred from names.
Risk.mitigation: Authoritative Directory Contract, get_instructions, deprecated alias denial and destination validation.

Risk.description: Admin dashboard leaks secrets or raw Vault content through logs or reports.
Risk.mitigation: Mandatory redaction in process events, dashboard responses and .log export.

Risk.description: Admin web interface becomes a direct Vault mutation path.
Risk.mitigation: Read-only dashboard service boundary and forbidden M-028 -> M-005/M-009 edges.

Risk.description: Mutation policy dry_run gate bypassed because _authorize_or_raise hardcodes dry_run=True instead of forwarding the actual call parameter.
Risk.mitigation: M-008._authorize_or_raise must accept and forward the actual dry_run parameter to M-003.authorize_operation. Static analysis or contract test must verify that authorize_operation sees the same dry_run value the caller passed.
